add.name: Add Focus
add.tip: Set an element as the focus element, and its descendant button elements can be switched with the arrow keys and confirmed with the Enter key.

setFocus-mode.label: Mode
setFocus-mode.tip: How to create the button list

control-child-buttons.name: Control Child Buttons
control-child-buttons.tip: Use shortcut keys to control buttons in child elements

control-descendant-buttons.name: Control Descendant Buttons
control-descendant-buttons.tip: Use shortcut keys to control buttons in descendant elements

setFocus-cancelable.label: Cancelable
setFocus-cancelable.tip: Press the Esc key to remove the current focus
